label: One step of AlphaFold 3's sampler
context: 1D-in-σ illustration in 2D: show a current noisy point x_i (dark dot) at noise level σ_i, and the clean target region (the denoiser's prediction D, blue dot) to the left. Phase 1 'churn': σ is raised to σ̂ = σ_i (1 + γ), γ = 0.8; fresh noise is added: x jumps to x̂ (draw a jagged warm arrow) and a σ-bar on the side grows. Phase 2 'Euler step': compute direction (x̂ − D)/σ̂ toward D; draw the plain Euler step (η = 1, dashed grey arrow ending at x_{i+1}^{η=1}) and then AF3's step with η = 1.5 (solid blue arrow, 1.5× longer) overshooting further toward D. Phase 3: repeat a few steps quickly showing the trajectory zig-zagging down in σ. Caption: 'add noise (γ₀ = 0.8, λ = 1.003), then step 1.5× too far toward the prediction (η = 1.5): a deliberately cold sampler'. Show σ values on a log axis. Canvas is responsive: width anywhere from 340 to 900 px, height 400 px; derive every size and position from width and height, keep all text at least 11 px and fully inside the canvas, and on narrow widths stack or shrink rather than overlap. Loop forever on a cycle of 10 to 16 s with smooth easing between phases. White background. Put a one-line phase caption at the top centre that changes with the phase. No title inside the canvas (the card has one). Use plain sans-serif labels.

spec.title: One step of AlphaFold 3's sampler: churn, then an over-long Euler step
